Tessaro Components to Expand Lindale Plant

LINDALE (May 8) — Tessaro Components, a maker of precision parts for medical devices, announced plans on Tuesday to add a 6,000-square-meter production hall to its Lindale facility. [1] The expansion, expected to cost $24 million, will allow the company to double its output of surgical instrument parts by 2029.

The company currently employs 340 people in Lindale. Plant director Yusuf Demir said that about 120 new positions would be created, most of them for machine operators and quality inspectors. [2] "We will be working with Lindale Technical College to design a training course so that local residents can qualify for these jobs," he said.

School furniture

explanation: 医療機器用の精密部品メーカーと紹介されている。

Subject: Updated expense reimbursement procedure

Dear colleagues,

Beginning November 1, all expense claims must be submitted through the new ExpenseFlow app rather than on paper forms. The app allows you to photograph receipts with your phone and attach them directly to your claim, which should reduce processing time from about three weeks to under ten days.

Please note the following changes to the policy itself. Meals during business travel will now be reimbursed up to $65 per day, up from $50. However, claims submitted more than 60 days after the expense was incurred will no longer be accepted except with written approval from a department director.

Training sessions on the app will be held on October 15 and 22. Anyone unable to attend may watch a recorded version on the intranet.

Bernard Ochoa
